results.title: Use of the Analytic Hierarchy Process and Selected ...
results.content: The aim of the paper is to analyze and describe the AHP method as essential for strategic managerial decision-making to determine which method is efficient for the calculation and to set the proper order of criteria. In the article, there are included methods that can be used in order to calculate the matrix in the AHP process for setting criteria. Many authors have used the AHP method in the decision-making process to select the best alternative from several options. Managers’ attitude towards the AHP method in the decision-making process after determining its difficulty. The AHP method follows three steps in the decision-making process, including (1) the structure of the model; (2) the comparison of the criteria and alternatives and calculation of the weights; and (3) the synthesis of priorities. The survey performed among managers on different levels of management showed that the most complex method of the AHP process in managerial decision-making is the Saaty method (see Figure 8).
